SPEND EXPLODED: $3.89 -> $30.00 in one day, an 8x jump, on a $15.00/day budget. $30.00 is EXACTLY 2x the daily budget, which is the hard ceiling Google will spend on a single day -- so the account did not merely increase, it PINNED THE CAP. The engagement side looks genuinely strong, not wasted: CTR went 2.22% -> 10.14% and clicks 4 -> 14 on 42 FEWER impressions, so the traffic that did serve converted to clicks at nearly five times the prior rate.
